standfirst: 45 stories across 6 sectors · consolidated from 48 reports of 233 collected

stories.title: AI stocks rally after Anthropic IPO filing, Nvidia gains nearly 3%
stories.dek: AI stocks rallied after Anthropic disclosed IPO paperwork, with Nvidia gaining nearly 3% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbing over 3%. Chipmakers, data centre operators and AI infrastructure firms also advanced.

stories.title: Australia warns of 'unprecedented' AI threat
stories.dek: Artificial intelligence poses an "unprecedented" threat as foreign governments turn it loose to hack computer networks and critical infrastructure, Australia's cyber security agency warned on Tuesday.

stories.title: India-Russia trade grew by 20 per cent this year: Russian State Duma Chairman
stories.dek: India imported $44.9 billion of Russian goods during the period, including $36 billion in crude oil. Indian exports to Russia totaled $2.8 billion, with Moscow increasing purchases of chemicals, electrical goods, medical equipment, seafood, tea, and spices.

stories.title: Indian bonds tick up on calm oil before Fed verdict
stories.dek: In early trade, Indian government bonds improved as oil prices found stability after last week's surge. Traders remained cautious ahead of a significant policy decision by the US Federal Reserve on Wednesday.

stories.title: Ather Energy shares jump 5%, extend rally to 20% in two days after Q2 results. Can the run continue?
stories.dek: Ather Energy shares extended their rally on Tuesday after the electric two-wheeler maker reported its first quarterly profit of Rs 1.26 crore in Q2 FY27. Revenue surged 63% year-on-year to Rs 1,464 crore, while EBITDA turned positive.

stories.title: Dalmia Bharat shares hit 52-week low after Q2 results - Should investors buy, sell, or hold the stock? Experts take
stories.dek: Dalmia Bharat shares fell 7.4% to a 52-week low after the cement maker reported September-quarter revenue growth of 4% but a ₹205 crore loss.

stories.title: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include possible harms from runaway AI
stories.dek: The risks laid out by the San Francisco company in its filing Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission included discussion of bad actors potentially using AI models to build deadly weapons or the technology itself going rogue with untold…

stories.title: Yuan holds near four-year high as China tempers appreciation pace
stories.dek: China's yuan held near a four-year high against the US dollar as the central bank moderated its daily fixing. Export-related demand and stronger industrial profits supported the currency, while global markets awaited key central bank decisions.

stories.title: IT stocks crash! Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCL Tech - Nifty IT tanks over 2% today, biggest sectoral loser
stories.dek: Indian IT stocks fell sharply on October 27, with the Nifty IT index down 2.3%, as investors weighed AI-driven disruption, global uncertainty and elevated valuations.

stories.title: TCS, Infosys, other IT stocks drop up to 3% as Anthropic IPO sparks rally in global AI stocks
stories.dek: Indian IT stocks fell amid reports that Anthropic, the maker of Claude, is preparing for an IPO that could value it at around $1.5 trillion.

stories.title: Sona BLW Precision Forgings shares rally 6% after Q2 profit rises 29%, revenue jumps 35%
stories.dek: Sona Comstar shares surged nearly 6% after the company reported record Q2FY27 revenue and profit, driven by robust growth in its electric-vehicle business, new orders and product launches.

stories.title: India-US Trade Facilitation Portal records 3,500 registrations within months of launch: Piyush Goyal
stories.dek: Around 3,500 registrations have been recorded on the India-US Trade Facilitation Portal since its launch. This platform aims to connect Indian exporters with US-based buyers for improved trade relationships.

stories.title: Wheat sowing lags at 11,000 hectare so far amid deficient monsoon; rabi acreage down
stories.dek: Wheat sowing in India has reached 11,000 hectares as of October 23, against 27,000 hectares a year earlier, as a deficient southwest monsoon raises concerns over soil moisture and irrigation availability.

stories.title: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos
stories.dek: On Monday, Instagram announced that it is testing out video lengths of up to 90 minutes with select creators in the US.

stories.title: RBI steps up liquidity support as tighter cash conditions push up borrowing rates: Report
stories.dek: Tightening liquidity in the banking system has pushed up short-term borrowing rates, prompting the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to inject funds into banks, according to an ICICI Bank report.

stories.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal
stories.dek: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO by the numbers, from a possible valuation in the trillions to surging revenue
stories.dek: The artificial intelligence lab filed papers Monday setting up a Wall Street debut next month, ahead of its chief rival OpenAI and just months after SpaceX set records in June with an initial public offering that raised $86 billion.

stories.title: Why Walmart would rather keep Flipkart private, for now
stories.dek: Over the past few weeks, much has been written about former employees of the online commerce company writing to Walmart's board, asking for liquidity on the stock options they were granted 10 to 15 years ago.

stories.title: VerSe valuation sinks; Paytm Q2 profit rises
stories.dek: Happy Tuesday! Dailyhunt parent VerSe Innovation's valuation has taken a sharp hit. This and more in today's ETtech Morning Dispatch.

stories.title: Govt seeks investor and expert views on LTCG and STT as it reviews capital market levies amid FPI exodus
stories.dek: The government has initiated a reassessment of long-term capital gains tax and securities transaction tax. Stakeholders, including investors and tax experts, have been consulted for their views.

stories.title: Cotton shortage set to worsen as new deals drive export demand
stories.dek: The impact of El Nino weather conditions could further hurt domestic production, expected to fall by 3.4% to a new low in the 2026-27 crop year ended September.

stories.title: FTA with India will be a game changer in supply chain management: EU ambassador to India
stories.dek: EU ambassador to India Jean-Eric Paquet further said, "We are creating an economic space across India and the European internal market.

stories.title: EU can learn from India on cutting regulatory burden, says Piyush Goyal as Dutch minister rules out CBAM rethink
stories.dek: Piyush Goyal addressed the India-Netherlands Business Forum, highlighting India's deregulation efforts to reduce burdens on businesses. He asserted that the EU could learn from India's successful approach to regulatory matters.

stories.title: Junior doctors, interns at Kolkata govt. hospital allege threats over stampede claims
stories.dek: Senior doctors back the interns, alleging a witch hunt over questions on hospital facilities and patient referrals to private hospitals

stories.title: Human error led to escape of prisoners, says DGP-Prisons
stories.dek: Security audit of all prisons had been ordered after the escape of a prisoner in Puzhal recently

stories.title: Jana Sena's MLC claim sparks unease in Telangana BJP
stories.dek: Telangana BJP president N. Ramachander Rao widely seen as the frontrunner for the Hyderabad-Rangareddy-Mahabubnagar Graduates' constituency

stories.title: SC to hear pleas against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, decisions during SIR
stories.dek: The ECI, Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the two Election Commissioners have filed a joint affidavit highlighting that any attempt to restrain the functioning of the CEC will be contrary to law

stories.title: Bangladesh leader raises concerns over Assam forest eviction drive, State minister counters
stories.dek: Bangladesh Opposition leader Shafiqur Rahman expressed deep concern over the eviction of Muslim families and demolition of mosques in the State's Lutumari-Longjap Reserve Forest

stories.title: Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank MD & CEO
stories.dek: Anup Bagchi has taken charge as the managing director and chief executive officer of HDFC Bank. He succeeds Sashidhar Jagdishan, who completed his tenure on October 26.

stories.title: Over 99.32 lakh names struck off voter list in Karnataka
stories.dek: Karnataka's electorate now stands at 4,55,00,011, down from 5,54,32,314 voters before the SIR began

stories.title: ECI's stand that additional declaration is not part of Form 6 comes days after SC said it will examine 'new' Form 6
stories.dek: The ECI has introduced an additional declaration form along with Form 6 which require these voters to provide details of their earlier electoral roll entries or that of their parents or grandparents

stories.title: Keralam police alerted; combing operations under way in forest areas, says officer
stories.dek: The special teams have shared the pictures of the escaped accused with officers at different locations across Tamil Nadu and Keralam

stories.title: Big relief for IT employees: 17 stations of Pune Metro Line 3 to open on November 3; PM Modi to inaugurate Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar corridor
stories.dek: Pune Metro Line 3: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to virtually inaugurate Pune Metro Line 3 on November 3, with 17 stations on the 23.3-km Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar corridor set to open to passengers.

stories.title: BIG FM applies for six more news channels, acquires Sapphire Media's news business
stories.dek: BIG FM has submitted a request to the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting for launching six news channels. This expansion aims to create a national news network combining traditional and digital broadcasting.

stories.title: Air India issues travel advisory as Cyclone Arnab threatens flights to Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada
stories.dek: In light of Cyclone Arnab, Air India has issued a travel warning about anticipated disruptions to flights serving Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada.

stories.title: L&T wins orders worth ₹5,000-₹10,000 crore for Dhaka Metro
stories.dek: L&T has secured design-and-build orders worth ₹5,000 crore to ₹10,000 crore for two systems packages of Bangladesh's Dhaka Metro Line 1, the country's first underground metro project.

stories.title: Ather rides to profit; Pronto's US AI play
stories.dek: Ather Energy swung to profit in the July-September quarter. This and more in today's ETtech Top 5.

stories.title: Indian startups can redefine how we fly, says aviation minister Rammohan Naidu after meeting indigenous eVTOL maker
stories.dek: India's aviation landscape is set to soar with the introduction of eVTOL aircraft developed by Nalwa Aero, based in Punjab. This cutting-edge electric transport system will facilitate air taxis, streamline medical evacuations, and enhance cargo delivery.

stories.title: Digital payments mandatory for liquor purchases above Rs 1,000 in Tamil Nadu from November 1: Check what changes
stories.dek: Tamil Nadu's state-run TASMAC will make digital payments mandatory for liquor purchases exceeding Rs 1,000 from November 1. Customers can pay through UPI, debit cards or credit cards, while cash payments will remain an option for purchases within the limit.

stories.title: Snacking brand Troovy raises fresh funding of Rs 100 crore
stories.dek: Clean-label snacking brand Troovy has raised Rs 100 crore in a funding round led by Fireside Ventures and Sharrp Ventures, more than double the Rs 45.8 crore it secured in January.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor India to hike production capacity to 1.14 mn units by 2030,boost localisation
stories.dek: Hyundai Motor India plans to raise annual production capacity to 1.14 million vehicles by 2030 and increase localisation to 92% by 2032 as it expands its manufacturing base in India.

stories.title: John Abraham joins India's first superbike league as strategic advisor
stories.dek: John Abraham has been appointed as a strategic advisor to the Indian Superbike League for its establishment. The league will combine professional motorcycle racing with entertainment and motorcycle culture in India.

stories.title: Hyundai reveals ambitious plan at new Bayon launch; Creta to be part of big push as well
stories.dek: The mid-size utility vehicle category, comprising SUVs and MPVs measuring 4-4.4 metres in length, recorded sales of around 9 lakh units in the last financial year.

stories.title: Yokohama expands Geolandar X-CV range to 37 sizes, targets India's SUV market
stories.dek: Yokohama India plans to add five new sizes to its Geolandar X-CV tyre range shortly. This expansion aims to cater to the growing crossover SUV market in India. The new sizes accommodate various SUV applications ranging from 16-inch to 20-inch.

stories.title: Jeep Compass gets new 9-speed automatic diesel variant; check price, features, delivery date
stories.dek: Jeep India has announced the launch of the Compass Sport FWD equipped with a 9-speed automatic transmission. This new variant is priced at ₹21.99 lakh and is the most affordable automatic version of the Jeep Compass.
